contentText:
Strange New Worlds is one of many Star Trek shows currently available on Paramount Plus. | Image: Marni Grossman / Paramount Plus

Paramount Plus (monthly subscription)

Where to Buy:

- $8.99 $2.99 at Paramount (Essential)

- $13.99 $2.99 at Paramount (Premium)

Paramount Plus lets you watch a variety of CBS shows, including all major Star Trek series, along with classic shows like South America South Park , NCIS, and Everybody Loves Raymond. It’s also the streaming home of Taylor Sheridan-produced shows like Tulsa King , Marshals , and Dutton Ranch , as well as the Yellowstone spinoffs 1883 and 1923 . In addition to the aforementioned shows, you also get access to a sizable chunk of Paramount’s film catalog, including titles like Arrival, Top Gun, and Interstellar , to name a few.

Beyond its library of movies and television shows, Paramount Plus hosts a wide range of live sporting events. The schedule varies each week, but it includes some NFL games, UFC events, UEFA Champions League matches, and March Madness games. The ad-free Premium plan also includes original Showtime shows, plus live streaming access to CBS, though you’ll still see ads when watching live content.
